messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up 1: we're doing a mock SLO reporting packet for Orion Health before renewal. Need clear owners and a reproducible evidence bundle.
Samira Khan: I can take the packet layout + slide deck. Want it to be two pages: 1) SLOs + observed metrics, 2) credit calc + timeline.
Liam O'Connor: I'll grab the latency exports. Ops should confirm warm vs cold run separation.
Ethan Gomez: Oncall will produce CSVs + trace links. Note: include cold-start removal logic we used in the dashboard (exclude first 5 mins of warmup).
Maya Patel: Good call. Also include a one-line plain-English summary of impact for execs. Samira, add that to the top.
Samira Khan: Will do. Question: do we show p50/p90/p95/p99? Customer asked for p95 and p99 but product wants p90 for internal benchmarking.
Liam O'Connor: Let's include p50, p90, p95, p99 with p95 highlighted. Keep the chart small.
Ethan Gomez: Ops note: for uptime, we should supply minute-level health and list any maintenance windows. If a maintenance was customer-scheduled, mark it.
Maya Patel: CS Bot 1: attach latest credit-calculator and the evidence checklist please.
CS Bot: Attached: /templates/slo_credit_calc_v3.xlsx, /runbooks/evidence_checklist_v1.pdf
Samira Khan: Draft snippet for the customer opener: "We measured your service against the agreed SLOs over the trailing 30 days. Below is a concise summary of observed behavior and any credits due." Thoughts?
Maya Patel: Nice. Add a line: "We value transparency — items below can be drilled into on request."
Liam O'Connor: Concrete example for the calc (put in the packet):
```
period_minutes = 30 * 24 * 60  # 30 days
baseline = 0.9995  # 99.95%
observed = 0.9958  # 99.58%
downtime_min = (baseline - observed) * period_minutes
# credit formula used: credit_pct = round(((baseline - observed) / (1 - baseline)) * 100, 2)
# then credit_amount = credit_pct * monthly_invoice_amount / 100
```
Samira Khan: Include a worked dollar figure example too. I'll put hypothetical $/minute and show steps.
Ethan Gomez: Ops will export: uptime CSV, per-minute health, p95/p99 latency, incident IDs + short summary, maintenance log, and trace links. ETA EOD today.
Maya Patel: Who's presenting on the renewal call? Samira to lead, Liam to run through metrics, I'll handle Q&A.
Samira Khan: Scheduling rehearsal: Thu 9:00 PT. Can everyone make it?
Liam O'Connor: Yes.
Ethan Gomez: Yes.
Maya Patel: CS Bot 1: please create the calendar invite and include the checklist in the description.
CS Bot: Calendar event created: Thu 9:00 PT. Checklist included.
Samira Khan: One more item 1: add an FAQ appendix: short answers to "Why p95 vs p99?", "How are credits rounded?", "Will a credit change billing terms?" Keep answers 1-2 lines.
Maya Patel: Agreed. Also, capture customer-sent metrics if they provide them and show a reconciliation table in the packet.
Liam O'Connor: I'll add a reconciliation section: our metrics vs customer-provided, with notes on collection differences.
Ethan Gomez: Filing ops ticket now to get the CSV exports and traces. Ticket #OPS-7412.
Maya Patel: Great. After the rehearsal we'll collect feedback and update the runbook. Keep all edits in this thread so we don't lose provenance. Thanks team :sparkles:
